action.command: cd /workspace && su ddevuser -c "ddev composer validate --no-check-all --no-check-publish" 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "=== vendor autoload ==="; ls -la vendor/autoload.php web/autoload.php 2>&1; echo "=== ddev config ==="; grep -E "php_version|database|type|docroot" .ddev/config.yaml 2>/dev/null | head
